description:
Fellowship overview

This Radboud PhD develops physics-informed generative models for synthetic energy data. The researcher will work on models that respect physical networks and operational constraints, helping produce privacy-preserving data for grid planning and energy-sector decisions.

Research Areas

  • Generative AI
  • Energy systems
  • Privacy-preserving data

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionSalaried PhD position
Stipend / salaryEUR 3,204–4,051 gross/month
Duration1.5-year initial contract; 2.5-year extension after positive evaluation

The salary starts at EUR 3,204 gross per month and increases to EUR 4,051 in year four. Holiday allowance and year-end bonus are additional.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationMSc, completed or expected before the start, in computing, AI, data science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering or a related field.
LanguageGood spoken and written English required
Further conditionsRelevant MSc; English; four-year appointment subject to first-stage evaluation.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round25 October 2026
LocationNetherlands

About Radboud University

Radboud offers doctoral and postdoctoral research through its faculties and institutes in Nijmegen. Advertised research positions set out the scientific project, qualifications, employment terms and application route.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Open the application portal

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 25 October 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 25 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

English language requirements

Like most Dutch doctoral vacancies, this employed PhD position does not ask for an IELTS or TOEFL certificate. Selection is based on your CV, transcripts, references and an interview conducted in English, so fluent academic English and a strong research record carry more weight than a test score.
